title: Name and terms
summary: First of the two typing steps: the name people see in chats, and the clickwrap checkbox for the Terms of use and the Privacy policy (ADR 0113).

displayName.description: The name field. Trimmed before use, at most 100 characters.

termsAccepted.description: The checkbox. Starts unticked on every visit to the step.

termsVersion.description: The legalVersion that the checkbox accepts: terms_version from GET /v1/signup/config, else legalVersion from registries/legal.json.

inviterHandle.description: From the pending invite. Shows bipe_signup_invited_by above the field.

showTermsRequired.description: true after signup-create got terms_required. Shows bipe_signup_terms_required.

openTerms.effect: Opens the Terms of use in the system browser: PUBLIC_SITE_URL plus termsPath (pt) or enTermsPath (en) from registries/legal.json.

openPrivacy.effect: Opens the Privacy policy the same way, with privacyPath or enPrivacyPath.

continue.effect: Goes to signup-pin. Off while the trimmed name is empty or termsAccepted is false.

notes: bipe_signup_terms_accept takes the two link texts as %1$s and %2$s. Each link text is tappable on its own; a tap on the rest of the sentence flips the checkbox.
The app sends terms_version with POST /v1/signup only when termsAccepted is true. The server refuses an older version (403 terms_required).
The @ is not asked here. It comes later from the handle prompt (handle-pick). The second-account flow (ADR 0135) also starts at this step.
Bipe logic: BipeLegalLinks.termsURL and privacyURL (iOS), BipeLegalLinks.termsUrl and privacyUrl (Android).
